name: Insider Option – Instagram Congress Trade Poster

parameters.content:
## Env vars required in n8n

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `INSIDER_OPTION_API_URL` | base URL of your backend |
| `IMAGE_GENERATOR_URL` | your image-gen Render service URL |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | from console.anthropic.com |
| `IG_USER_ID` | Instagram Business Account ID |
| `IG_ACCESS_TOKEN` | long-lived IG access token |

## API contract
`GET /api/trades/congress/latest` must return:
```json
{
  "id": "trade-123",
  "ticker": "NVDA",
  "politician": "Nancy Pelosi",
  "party": "Democrat",
  "age": 84,
  "job_title": "Member of Congress",
  "type": "Purchase",
  "amount_min": 250000,
  "amount_max": 500000,
  "trade_date": "2026-05-06",
  "filed_date": "2026-05-08"
}
```

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ticker: $json.ticker, politician: $json.politician, party: $json.party, age: $json.age, job_title: $json.job_title, type: $json.type, amount_min: $json.amount_min, amount_max: $json.amount_max, trade_date: $json.trade_date, filed_date: $json.filed_date, tagline: $json.tagline, id: $json.id }) }}
